response.rationale: C1 is the append-only completion of R5 and adds the exact ventral cervical anatomical modifier to the same diagnosis, making it the most complete and well-supported candidate. R5 has equivalent core inflammatory/mass evidence but lacks the explicit anatomical descriptor; R2 overreads a nonspecific mass, R1 is contradicted by warmth and leukocytosis, and R3 has no raw support.

rejected.why: Only raw support is a nonspecific subcutaneous mass; it does not explain fluctuance, warmth, or neutrophilic leukocytosis.
Hematoma is supported only by fluctuance and is directly contradicted by the mildly warm quality and leukocytosis.
Granuloma lacks any raw support span and relies only on non-raw generator assessment; it does not fit the acute warm fluctuant mass with neutrophilia.
